name: Anthropic Claude
description: Installs the Claude Code extension and the default ~/.claude/settings.json file (the Google Cloud CLI is installed in the Dockerfile)
postAttachCommand: if [ -e ~/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json ]; then printf '\033[32mGoogle Cloud credentials present\033[0m\n'; else printf '\033[33mNot logged in to Google Cloud, run gcloud-login.sh\033[0m\n'; fi
